title: Novel iodinated quinazolinones bearing sulfonamide as new scaffold targeting radiation induced oxidative stress.
authors: Soliman, Aiten M; Mekkawy, Mai H; Karam, Heba M; Higgins, Maureen; Dinkova-Kostova, Albena T; Ghorab, Mostafa M
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成碘化喹唑啉酮类化合物并评估其抗氧化与辐射防护活性，仅涉及小分子与Keap1蛋白的对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) play an integral role in the pathogenesis of most diseases. This work presents the design and synthesis of fourteen new diiodoquinazolinone derivatives bearing benzenesulfonamide moiety with variable acetamide tail and evaluation of their ability to activate nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) using its classical target NAD(P)H: quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1) in Hepa1c1c7 murine hepatoma cells. The N-(2-chloropyridin-3-yl)-2-((6,8-diiodo-4-oxo-3-(4-sulfamoylphenyl)-3,4-dihydroquinazolin-2-yl)thio) acetamide 17 was the most potent NQO1 inducer (CD = 25 microM) with free radical scavenging activity (IC(50) = 28 microM) and in vivo median lethal dose (LD(50)) of 500 mg/Kg. The possible radioprotective activity of compound 17 was evaluated in (7 Gy) irradiated mice. Compound 17 showed a reduction in radiation induced oxidative stress as evidenced by the lower levels of ROS, malondialdehyde (MDA) and NQO1 in liver tissues. Moreover, compound 17 showed improvement in the complete blood count (CBC) of irradiated mice and decreased mortality over 30 days following irradiation. Additionally, docking studies inside the Nrf2-binding site of Kelch-like ECH associated protein 1 (Keap1), the main negative regulator of Nrf2, confirmed that 17 revealed the same interactions with the key amino acids as those of the co-crystallized ligand. This study identifies 17 as a novel antioxidant that protects against the harmful effect of radiation.
abstract_zh: 活性氧（ROS）在大多数疾病的发病机制中发挥重要作用。本研究设计并合成了十四个带有苯磺酰胺部分及不同乙酰氨基尾链的新型二碘喹唑啉酮衍生物，并评估了它们通过其经典靶标NAD(P)H：醌氧化还原酶1（NQO1）在Hepa1c1c7小鼠肝癌细胞中激活核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）的能力。N-(2-氯吡啶-3-基)-2-((6,8-二碘-4-氧代-3-(4-磺酰胺基苯基)-3,4-二氢喹唑啉-2-基)硫代)乙酰胺（化合物17）是最有效的NQO1诱导剂（CD = 25微摩尔），具有自由基清除活性（IC(50) = 28微摩尔），体内半数致死剂量（LD(50)）为500毫克/千克。在（7戈瑞）辐照小鼠中评估了化合物17可能的辐射防护活性。化合物17显示出辐射诱导氧化应激的降低，表现为肝脏组织中ROS、丙二醛（MDA）和NQO1水平较低。此外，化合物17改善了辐照小鼠的完全血细胞计数（CBC），并在辐照后30天内降低了死亡率。另外，在Nrf2的主要负调控因子Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）的Nrf2结合位点内的对接研究证实，化合物17与关键氨基酸的相互作用与共结晶配体相同。本研究将化合物17鉴定为一种新型抗氧化剂，可防护辐射的有害影响。
